messages:
alice.h: Heads up — vuln triage needs a short-lived SIEM snapshot for INC-1532. Who can approve and what TTL? Avoid direct KMS unwrap for analysts.
ben.m: Don't give humans raw KMS decrypt. Suggest: proxy unwrap only, ephemeral role, TTL 6h for token. :thinking_face:
claire.s: 6h is tight across shifts. Recommend 24h token with auto-roll and full audit.
dinesh: We can allow 24h if request includes JIT ticket link, scoped role claim, mandatory scrub profile, and justification field.
oncall-bot: @alice.h — note: if during handoff, approver = primary oncall + security lead. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-ephemeral
sec-bot: All unwraps must emit audit events. Tag snapshots with investigation:INC-1532 and record snapshot id in immutable index.
alice.h: Draft request template (put in ticket body):
{
  "ticket": "INC-1532",
  "requester": "alice.h",
  "reason": "vuln triage - suspected credential leak",
  "snapshot_scope": ["auth-logs:7d", "api-gateway:7d"],
  "desired_ttl_hours": 24,
  "scrub_level": "PII-mask",
  "approver": "security-lead"
}
ben.m: Snapshot flow: 1) scrub pipeline, 2) encrypt with CMK, 3) store blob + metadata, 4) create ephemeral assume-role with TTL, 5) proxy unwrap logs only.
claire.s: Export retention for investigator copies? Cap at 90d with auto-delete; legal-hold requires sec-compliance escalation.
dinesh: Policy: evaluation snapshots max 90d, auto-delete job. Legal holds via ticket and justification.
alice.h: Where to record snapshot->ticket mapping? Needs append-only.
ben.m: Use audit-dynamo write-once pattern + Lambda guard. Keys: snapshot_id, ticket_id, created_by, expires_at, scrub_profile, approver, unwrap_log_id.
oncall-bot: Emergency unmasking during incident requires 2-person approval + 30m SLA.
sec-bot: Add RBAC PR note: ephemeral access paths and justification must be recorded in changelog.
claire.s: I'll draft PR and on-call checklist this afternoon.
dinesh: I'll build Lambda guard and test harness. ETA EOD tomorrow for infra stub + docs.
alice.h: I'll open the formal request and tag @claire.s as approver. :white_check_mark:
